meta.title: Filters last for the session (tab switch, Place and Back) but not across a restart
meta.requirement: AC5 + AC7 — filters kept; Back keeps filters and list position
precondition: Guest, location granted + mock at Tashkent centre
steps: Open another tab and return to Explore
Scroll the list down by 3 swipes, remember the first visible card slug, open a card, tap Back
Force-stop and relaunch the app, open Explore
expected: After the tab round trip the Type chip still reads 'Lakes' and the header is 11 — UI tree + screenshot
After Place → Back the chip is unchanged and the first visible card is the same slug as before opening (position kept) — UI tree + screenshot
After a cold restart the chip has no value and the header is 71 (session only) — UI tree + screenshot
